steps.what: Specify the actual extraterrestrial target, emission band, observation configuration and calibration references
Check immediate instrument and observing readiness for the exact configuration under actual facility authority
Operate and monitor the actual instrument to acquire the specified radio, infrared, gamma or x-ray emissions
outputs: actual emission measurements and calibration observations

steps.what: Assemble the specified calibrated emission measurements and uncertainty summary from the actual observation files
inputs: actual emission measurements and calibration observations

steps.what: Check actual signal quality, calibration applicability, artifacts and uncertainty against the observation files
inputs: actual emission measurements and calibration observations

steps.what: Write the actual measurement note used by the research analysis, including calibration versions and rejected observations
Save the ordinary measurement note in the same research workspace

tasks.design: Use a fixed calibration-summary pipeline in {OTHER}, the astronomical instrument and reduction environment, with {SPREADSHEET} only where actual manual summary assembly remains. Keep configuration, live operation, scientific checks and the real measurement note in {DOCS} with the astronomer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Some measurement campaigns manually combine calibrated files and uncertainty fields after acquisition.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit file schemas and selected calibration rules can generate that defined summary without interpreting the source.
tasks.still_hard: Band-specific backgrounds, instrument artifacts and uncertain calibration affect measurement validity.
tasks.human_edge: The astronomer recognizes when a nominal measurement is not scientifically usable.

ambition.what: Inspect more valid measurement comparisons after actual quality checks.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed reduction rules can assemble emission summaries while band-specific calibration and signal validity require scientific checks.

assumptions: Actual instrument acquisition is produced in s3 and inspected in s5; no free clean data feed is presumed. Shares refer to human work, not unattended exposure or computation time.

s1 defines the exact observation before s2 checks current readiness; a1 gates a real instrument action, not authored paperwork. Confirm actual facility authority and use the real authorized operator if different. Changed configuration or conditions require a new check.

Test native acquisition and reduction tools first. Existing calibration, file generation and runtime earn zero new labour gain. s4 applies only to an actual currently manual summary assembly; do not invent one where the pipeline already does it.

s5 retains investigation and rejection of invalid data; upkeep includes failed file/schema repair. The actual measurement note is used in research analysis, not a trailing report invented after observation. Save1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated.
Publication or forecast release is outside this measurement boundary and needs its actual authority and separate final-version action. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Is manual calibrated-summary assembly left after the actual band-specific pipeline?

already_counted.description: Observation specification, readiness, actual operation, scientific verification and real measurement-note writing remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain calibration-summary mappings and repair failed file/schema cases.

approvals.approved_version: Exact observation configuration determined in s1 under current readiness checked in s2; changed configuration or conditions void authorization.

tasks.short: Develop astronomical instruments and analysis software

steps.what: Define actual astronomical observation requirements, instrument interfaces and validation cases
Design and physically develop the actual prototype instrumentation and inspect its interfaces
outputs: actual prototype instrumentation and interface findings

steps.what: Develop the specified observation or analysis software against the actual interface specification
inputs: actual prototype instrumentation and interface findings

loop.purpose: Suggest specification-bound observation or analysis code
loop.input: Actual interface specification and reference test cases
loop.check: Astronomer reads changes and checks units, device semantics and scientific output against real fixtures in s4
loop.stop: Two attempts, then unresolved code is completed manually within retained work and counted repair
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed interface templates handle repetition but new analysis behavior has specification-dependent meaning

steps.what: Validate the actual prototype and changed software on authorized development fixtures and inspect scientific failures
inputs: actual prototype instrumentation and interface findings

steps.what: Write the development note used by instrument collaborators, including actual interfaces, test outcomes and unresolved limits
Save the ordinary local working code and development note in their existing workspace

tasks.design: Use a bounded code assistant in {OTHER}, the instrument development, scientific coding and test environment, against the actual interface specification. A {DOCS} layout inserts interface and test-reference fields while physical development and scientific validation stay human.
tasks.previous_blocker: New interfaces require setup coding and repeated test-reference insertion into real development notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Specification-bound code suggestions and native document fields can remove those particular writing actions.
tasks.still_hard: Instrument behavior, physical tolerances and scientifically misleading outputs demand actual validation.
tasks.human_edge: The astronomer connects the instrument's behavior to what the research question requires.

ambition.what: Develop additional validated analysis prototypes within actual instrument constraints.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: bounded code suggestions can support instrument software development when actual interfaces and scientific outputs are checked by the developer.

assumptions: Boundary is local prototype development and read-only validation on already authorized fixtures, not installation, energization, repository commit, deployment or operational instrument control. Actual formal releases or commands need their real authority and separate final-version action.
s1 produces the actual specification and s2 counts physical development and interface inspection; no free clean specification or prototype is assumed.
s3 retains6 of15 coding units and s4 retains20 validation units. Incremental work includes2 extra manual failure-repair units, so unresolved generated code is not a free fallback.

The development-note layout removes2.1 of14 interface/test-reference insertion units;11.9 remain for actual writing. Test native code templates and note fields first; existing functions earn zero new saving.
The actual note is read by instrument collaborators. Save1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Shares are unmeasured estimates.
research_questions: Can code suggestions pass real device-semantic and scientific fixtures within retained checks?

already_counted.description: Specification, physical development, retained code writing, full validation and substantive development documentation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain code fixtures and document fields2; manually repair failed suggestions2.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R88.9 gives gross11.1 less upkeep4, net7.1. Low: a new detector protocol has no compatible setup example, retaining13 of15 coding units and13 of14 documentation units;3 saved is below4 upkeep, net clamped0. Physical development and validation remain full.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual scientific proposal or paper, its supplements and the applicable review criteria
Read and critically assess the actual scientific argument, methods, evidence and limitations
Write the actual working review report and check that every criticism and recommendation follows the paper or proposal
Save the ordinary working review in the same document workspace

tasks.design: Keep the assigned document, supplements and review criteria together using native links in {PARTNER_PORTAL} and {DOCS}. Scientific assessment and the actual review report remain fully human; no manuscript or proposal content is sent to a model.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the correct supplements and criteria can require repeated document navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: A native assignment document set can remove that retrieval work without drafting or judging the review.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific novelty, methodological adequacy and fair criticism require expert judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The astronomer accepts responsibility for the actual evidence-based assessment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native assignment links can reduce document retrieval while scientific peer review and review writing remain expert work.

assumptions: Boundary is review through a saved working report. Actual submission to an editor or panel needs its real reviewer authorization and separate gated send after the exact final report exists; no second author self-approval or invented supervisor is added here.
The actual editor or panel provides the assignment and documents through real editorial work outside focal labour. s1 counts this astronomer's document/version checks.

The linked document set removes2 of10 navigation units;8 remain for selecting and checking actual files. Native review forms already provide structure, so no report-template or save saving is claimed.
Actual critical reading65 and report writing24 remain full. Save1 is negligible and ungated. Shares are unmeasured; no confidential-content model use is proposed.
research_questions: Is there any repeated supplement/criteria retrieval beyond existing portal support?

already_counted.description: Document/version checks, full scientific assessment and actual review report writing remain counted.

steps.what: Read the actual funding opportunity and locate relevant existing research and funder context
Prepare the actual research pitch used in the funding conversation, checking claims and project needs
Discuss the actual research and funding need with prospective funders and answer their questions

tasks.design: Link the actual funding opportunity and existing context in {CRM} and {DOCS}, then reuse only established pitch headings and research-reference fields. The astronomer checks the claims and conducts the actual funding conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparing a real funder conversation can repeat opportunity navigation and pitch-reference placement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native opportunity links and document fields can remove those particular assembly actions.
tasks.still_hard: Funder interest, trust and the actual research need require a personal conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The astronomer explains why the research matters without promising unsupported outcomes.

ambition.what: Prepare for additional genuinely suitable prospective funder conversations.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked opportunity context and reusable pitch fields can shorten preparation while research fundraising conversations remain human.

assumptions: Boundary is actual fundraising preparation and oral discussion, not grant application writing, a pledge, a funding agreement or a dispatched solicitation. Those actual artefacts and commitments need their own work and final-version authority.
s1 reads the actual opportunity and checks real context; s2 counts actual project-need and claim preparation. No free clean donor dataset or newly mandatory CRM capture is assumed.

s1 removes4 of25 navigation units, retaining21 for actual reading and fit checks. s2 removes2 of20 reference-placement/heading units, retaining18 for actual pitch preparation and claim checks. These are different actions and cuts, not a common percentage rule.

Test current native links and pitch layouts first; current support earns zero new gain. No trailing contact note is invented where none is kept or read. Ordinary working persistence is negligible within preparation and carries no saving or author approval.
Shares are unmeasured activity estimates; the actual funder conversation remains full.
research_questions: Which preparation actions remain manual after native opportunity and pitch tools?

already_counted.description: Actual funding-context reading, substantive pitch preparation and the funder conversation remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain funding-opportunity links and pitch reference fields.
